title: Simra closed testbench and measurement plan v1
description: A bounded, inspectable testbench graph. It contains no SPICE text, directives, behavioral elements, simulator options, or untyped expressions.

smallSignalAc.description: One explicitly oriented ideal small-signal current injection. No arbitrary source expression or simulator option is admitted.

pllLoopFilter.description: Closed passive third-order loop-filter topology. For s=j2*pi*f, Ztrans=(1+s*r1*c1)/(s*(c1+c2+s*c1*c2*(r1+r2))).

pllLoopConstruction.description: A negative-feedback charge-pump PLL loop. L(f)=(Icp/(2*pi))*Ztrans(j2*pi*f)*Kvco/(j*f*N); charge_pump_gain is the local Q-versus-phase-time slope, never a DC or pulse-average current.

linearAc.description: Log-frequency small-signal sweep; the closed compiler chooses simulator directives and options.

loopTransferMeasurement.description: Complex negative-feedback loop gain versus frequency, retaining magnitude and continuously unwrap-able phase.

unityFrequencyMeasurement.description: Frequency of the first descending |L|=1 crossing.

negativeFeedbackPhaseMarginMeasurement.description: 180 degrees plus continuously unwrapped phase of negative-feedback L at the selected unity frequency.

reductionCompliance.description: Widest contiguous axis interval where each signed curve remains within relative_tolerance of its own explicit midrail reference: abs(y-ref)<=relative_tolerance*abs(ref).
